title: Artifact first-publish blocked in scheduled-task session type
description: The watchtower-weekly dashboard artifact has never been created. Every Watchtower weekly run hits a hard platform constraint: the Artifact tool's first-time publish requires an approval card that the Cowork scheduled-task session type cannot serve. The error is: 'The first publish to an Artifact from this Cowork session needs the approval card, and no one can answer it in this session.' This is not a transient error — retrying in the same session always fails. The artifact does not appear in the gallery and no URL is stored in the repo.
correction: Dashboard artifact creation must happen in an interactive Cowork session, not a scheduled-task session. Once created and a URL obtained, store the URL in workflows/watchtower/config.yaml so future runs can update by URL rather than creating.
fix_required: Open an interactive session and say 'create the Watchtower Weekly dashboard artifact.' Store the resulting URL in config.yaml under artifact_url.
